title: Woman with Floating Demon Heads
prompt: A woman with long dark wavy hair stands in the center of a high-tech futuristic chamber with blue neon geometric wall panels and glowing floor lines. She wears a tight black futuristic bodysuit with bright white glowing circuit board patterns running down the torso and limbs. Her arms are extended sideways with palms facing upward in a commanding pose. Four large demonic heads with glossy black skin, prominent curved horns, menacing red glowing eyes, bared teeth and dark smoke emanating from them float in the air around her at different heights. Cinematic sci-fi lighting with cool blue tones and subtle red accents from the eyes, photorealistic, dramatic atmosphere
